$schema-note: Lists of {name,value,usage}. CSS variables are prefixed --t4g-.
name: Tech for Good

meta.driveFolder: Tech for Good 4.0/ 5th Anniversary for Techrity › Techrity Team T4G Designs
meta.styleGuide: Tech for Good Conference 2023 Brand Styleguide V2 (T4G 3.0), uploaded
meta.history: TechForGood 2.0 Branding Proposal (Sept 2022, Bright Chinenyeze) superseded by the 2023 styleguide

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page ground. The styleguide shows elements on light (white) and dark (#212121) backgrounds; flyers use both.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Headlines and body text (16.1:1 both ways). The T4G mark is #212121 on light grounds.

tokens.name: heading
tokens.usage: Anton headlines such as 'TECH FOR GOOD CONFERENCE 2023'.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: dates, credits, captions (6.2:1 on white, 8.6:1 on t4g-dark). The guide sets all text in #212121 or white, so this neutral fills the gap with no new hue.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Emphasis: Techrity Purple on light (4.7:1), lilac on dark (8.0:1).

tokens.name: hairline
tokens.usage: Dividers and card outlines. Decorative only, never text.

tokens.name: panther-pink
tokens.usage: Official T4G colour (Panther Pink, RGB 238 76 138). The 'X' element, labels and bullets. White text on it is 3.5:1 (large bold only); #212121 text 4.6:1.

tokens.name: tech-blue
tokens.usage: Official T4G colour (Tech Blue, RGB 1 100 245). The flower element and the 4.0 campaign headlines. 5.1:1 on white.

tokens.name: good-green
tokens.usage: Official T4G colour (Good Green, RGB 3 153 118). The four-point star element. White text 3.6:1 (large only); #212121 text 4.5:1.

tokens.name: techrity-purple
tokens.usage: Official T4G colour (named Techrity Purple in the T4G guide, RGB 136 75 255; not the parent's #463a93). The >>> chevrons, CTA blocks and the event-banner panel. White text 4.7:1.

tokens.name: t4g-dark
tokens.usage: Dark background and the T4G mark's ink.

tokens.name: t4g-lilac
tokens.usage: 4.0 campaign: highlighted words on dark or navy.

tokens.name: t4g-navy
tokens.usage: 4.0 campaign: footer bar and CTA cards. White text 17.6:1.

tokens.name: t4g-deep-purple
tokens.usage: 4.0 campaign: ticket and ribbon shapes. White text 12.9:1.

tokens.name: t4g-periwinkle
tokens.usage: 4.0 campaign: billboard and screen panel fills.

tokens.name: t4g-sky
tokens.usage: 4.0 campaign: contact-info box, with dark text.

tokens.name: t4g-mist
tokens.usage: Light lavender wash at the top of posters; the light end of T4G Gradient 01.

tokens.name: white
tokens.usage: Light background; elements and text on dark.

styles.name: poster-headline
styles.usage: The giant condensed caps word in tech-blue. Size measured from the poster, so it's approximate.

styles.name: poster-subhead
styles.usage: Line above the giant word, same colour and face.

styles.name: poster-card
styles.sample: SHAPE THE FUTURE OF TECH FOR GOOD
styles.usage: Condensed caps in the navy CTA card, with one phrase in t4g-lilac.

styles.name: t4g-display
styles.usage: Stacked event title, as on the April 2025 post (exact size from Canva).

styles.name: poster-body
styles.sample: Are you ready to take the challenge?
styles.usage: Body copy in monospace on white.

styles.name: poster-label
styles.usage: White caps on a panther-pink or techrity-purple bar.

styles.name: poster-url
styles.usage: Ticket URL in the pink pill on the navy footer.

styles.name: t4g-handle
styles.usage: Footer with social icons, website and handle.

tokens.name: space-poster-margin
tokens.usage: Left margin of logo, headline and copy on a 2000-wide poster (measured).

tokens.name: space-post-margin
tokens.usage: Left edge of the logo, title and footer on a 1080-wide post.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Ticket-URL pill, footer bar on posts.

tokens.name: radius-card
tokens.usage: Navy CTA card corners on posters (measured, approximate).

tokens.name: radius-stage
tokens.usage: Corners of the black stage panel on 1920 slides. Estimated from a preview.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Labels, CTA bars, the 5th-anniversary and QR blocks.
